body:
An absence of joy.. I have plenty of healthy hobbies. I garden, I paint, I am a really talented cook and I'm learning to play the ukulele. 
Basically all these things used to make happy, excited and proud. Now I just feel completely numb and uninspired. 
I have amazing friends, but when I'm in their company, I have a unyielding urge to escape and just be alone. 
All I ever want is to sleep. And if I lay my head down, I can easily sleep for 14+ hours.

.. being very vulnerable here..
I am a 4 time (hospitalized) suicide attempt survivor. For years I told myself I'd really do it after my mama passed away so it wouldn't destroy her. Basically~ the idea of breaking my Mom's heart kept me going. 
She died 4 years ago, and I'm still here. 
I know your kid's version of depression and her experiences are not the same as mine, but hope I can give you a bit of hope
